matched_structure_detail: 40 primary + 40 patient-matched recurrent IDH-wildtype GBM specimens (80 total human tumors); longitudinal pairs confirmed in study design
treatment_detail: All patients treated with standard-of-care only: temozolomide (TMZ) + radiation + surgical resection; no bevacizumab or experimental agents
cell_count_approx: ~200000+ nuclei (snRNA-seq); 113 GEO samples including snATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial proteomics
organism: Homo sapiens (primary); Mus musculus (mouse IR model, subset)

publication.title: A single-cell atlas of glioblastoma evolution under therapy reveals cell-intrinsic and cell-extrinsic therapeutic targets
publication.authors: Wang L, Jung J, Babikir H, et al. (Diaz Lab, UCSF)

raw_data_note: Authors state raw data not available due to privacy concerns; processed data + metadata downloadable from GEO FTP
recommended_analysis: Differential cell-state abundance (primary vs recurrent): proneural-to-mesenchymal shift quantification
TME immune cell dynamics: monocyte-derived macrophage expansion at recurrence
T-cell outlier analysis: identify hypermutated/T-cell-high recurrent tumors
Spatial co-localization of cell states using Visium data
snATAC-seq chromatin accessibility changes at recurrence (AP-1/mesenchymal regulators)
Cell-cell communication networks (paracrine/autocrine) primary vs recurrent
Integration with GLASS bulk WGS for mutation-phenotype correlation
rationale: GSE174554 is the single best available dataset for GLASS GBM next-resolution analysis. It is the only GEO dataset with: (1) fully public processed data, (2) confirmed patient-matched primary-recurrent pairs (40 pairs), (3) explicit standard-of-care treatment annotation (TMZ+RT), (4) multimodal single-cell resolution (snRNA + snATAC + spatial), and (5) high-impact publication (Nature Cancer 2022). GSE163120 was disqualified: human raw data is EGA-restricted, only 2 human conditions (not matched pairs), no treatment annotation, and is primarily a mouse dataset.
